scope.description: Phase 1 core parity matrix for the first seven migration-gap audit categories.
out_of_scope: plugin ecosystems not explicitly named by the first seven audit categories

gap_categories.1_long_tail_helper_coverage: Long-tail EEGLAB helper coverage across public function folders.
gap_categories.2_missing_or_legacy_pop_entry_points: Missing or legacy pop_* entry points and aliases.
gap_categories.3_unsupported_options: Implemented functions with unsupported EEGLAB options or modes.

stale_skip_policy.menu_reachable: Must be false: no EEGLAB or EEGPrep main-menu action reaches the function.
stale_skip_policy.documented_user_api: Must be false: current EEGLAB help/docs do not document it as a user API.
stale_skip_policy.called_by_in_scope_workflow: Must be false: no in-scope EEGPrep workflow needs it.
stale_skip_policy.required_by_parity_tests: Must be false: no existing or planned parity test requires it.
stale_skip_policy.needed_as_phase_helper: Must be false: phases 2-7 do not need it as a helper.
stale_skip_policy.likely_user_alias: Must be false: it is not a compatibility alias users are likely to type.
